limitations: Text extraction is diagnostic and does not recover all dimensions embedded in figures.
No rule in this file is automatically transferable to ASM2464PD Rev-A.
Numeric figure annotations are recorded as tested/reference values, not recommended Rev-A design values.

observations.observation: The guide compares differential-via reference void approaches and concludes the SI-suggested void is better than a circular void in frequency and time domain.
The guide gives the same qualitative conclusion for a 6-layer board: the SI-suggested void is better than a circular void in frequency and time domain.
Balanced GND vias are reported to have lower Scd21 than the unbalanced arrangement in the guide's 4-layer comparison.
The guide evaluates several GND-via-to-signal-via spacings and reports that time-domain impedance increases as the spacing increases.
The guide compares arc routing with a 135-degree-angle route and reports the arc implementation as better for the evaluated 4-layer case.
